name: atoms/symfony
description: Symfony bundle for Atoms: AtomsClient, the inbound callback stack, PSR-17/18 resolution, a Messenger queue bridge, and console wrappers around the atoms binary.

suggest.symfony/messenger: Routes AtomJob callbacks through Messenger (MessengerQueueBridge); without it, NullQueueBridge throws on first use
suggest.symfony/console: Registers the atoms:deploy / atoms:rollback / atoms:list console wrappers
suggest.guzzlehttp/psr7: Default PSR-17 factory used when psr17_factory is not configured
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Default PSR-18 client used when no atoms.http_client / ClientInterface service is configured
suggest.doctrine/doctrine-bundle: Configure the database connection used by callback nonce storage (^2.13 || ^3.0).
suggest.doctrine/migrations: Run the package callback nonce migration (^3.9).
suggest.doctrine/doctrine-migrations-bundle: Register the callback nonce migration with the application migration runner (^3.4.3).
suggest.predis/predis: Redis callback nonce storage when ext-redis is unavailable (^2.2 || ^3.0).
